card.name: Sentence-opening Other or No in label text
card.fires_on: The first word of a new sentence in drug-label text, such as "Other" before "factors", "Other important considerations", or "Therefore, no" before dosage adjustment. It follows a sentence about risk factors or findings.

modes.label: Other starting a sentence
modes.description: "Other" opens a sentence listing further risk factors after a risk statement.
modes.example: patients treated with neither of these risk factors.<< Other>> factors that increase the risk of GI bleeding

modes.label: Other important considerations
modes.description: The word "considerations" after "Other important" in a differential diagnosis sentence.
modes.example: Other important<< considerations>> in the differential diagnosis include central antich

modes.label: Therefore, no
modes.description: "no" after "Therefore," before a statement that no dose adjustment is needed.
modes.example: Therefore,<< no>> dosage adjustment is generally necessary in the elderly

card.plain: It marks the word that starts a follow-on point in a label, like "Other factors" or "Therefore, no".
